summary: Pseudo-classes style an element based on its state or position, so the HTML does not need extra classes. This page has a list, links, an input, and a button to try them on.
notes: Move the mouse over the links and the button to see :hover.
Press Tab to move through the links, input, and button. The focused one gets an outline from :focus-visible.
type="button" makes a button that does not submit a form.
pitfall: Adding a class like "first" or "odd" to list items by hand. Then every time you add an item you have to fix the classes; :nth-child does it automatically.
